original.text: Hetupaccayo, ārammaṇapaccayo, adhipatipaccayo, anantarapaccayo, samanantarapaccayo, sahajātapaccayo, aññamaññapaccayo, nissayapaccayo, upanissayapaccayo, purejātapaccayo, pacchājātapaccayo, āsevanapaccayo, kammapaccayo, vipākapaccayo, āhārapaccayo, indriyapaccayo, jhānapaccayo, maggapaccayo, sampayuttapaccayo, vippayuttapaccayo, atthipaccayo, natthipaccayo, vigatapaccayo, avigatapaccayoti.

original.text: Hetupaccayoti—hetū hetusampayuttakānaṁ dhammānaṁ taṁsamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṁ hetupaccayena paccayo.
original.edition: Mahāsaṅgīti Tipiṭaka (roman script, based on the Sixth Council edition), SuttaCentral bilara-data root/pli/ms; niggahita written ṁ

paraphrase: Root condition: the roots are conditions, by way of root, for the dhammas associated with them and for the matter they originate.

original.text: Yaṁ yaṁ dhammaṁ ārabbha ye ye dhammā uppajjanti cittacetasikā dhammā, te te dhammā tesaṁ tesaṁ dhammānaṁ ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo.
original.edition: Mahāsaṅgīti Tipiṭaka (roman script, based on the Sixth Council edition), SuttaCentral bilara-data root/pli/ms; niggahita written ṁ

paraphrase: Object condition: the visible-form base is a condition for eye-consciousness and its associates, and so for each sense; all dhammas are object conditions for mind-consciousness; whatever mental dhammas arise with reference to whatever dhamma, that dhamma is their object condition.

original.text: Utubhojanampi upanissayapaccayena paccayo. Puggalopi upanissayapaccayena paccayo. Senāsanampi upanissayapaccayena paccayo.
original.edition: Mahāsaṅgīti Tipiṭaka (roman script, based on the Sixth Council edition), SuttaCentral bilara-data root/pli/ms; niggahita written ṁ

paraphrase: Decisive-support condition: earlier wholesome, unwholesome and indeterminate states are decisive supports for later ones; climate and food, a person, and a lodging are also decisive-support conditions.

original.text: Kammapaccayoti—kusalākusalaṁ kammaṁ vipākānaṁ khandhānaṁ kaṭattā ca rūpānaṁ kammapaccayena paccayo. Cetanā sampayuttakānaṁ dhammānaṁ taṁsamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṁ kammapaccayena paccayo.
original.edition: Mahāsaṅgīti Tipiṭaka (roman script, based on the Sixth Council edition), SuttaCentral bilara-data root/pli/ms; niggahita written ṁ

paraphrase: Kamma condition: wholesome and unwholesome kamma is a condition for resultant aggregates and for kamma-born matter; volition is a condition for its associated dhammas and the matter they originate.
translation_basis: paraphrase made by the unit author from the Pali where the passage was read locally; otherwise from the author's knowledge of the text

original.text: Yaṁ rūpaṁ nissāya manodhātu ca manoviññāṇadhātu ca vattanti, taṁ rūpaṁ manodhātuyā ca manoviññāṇadhātuyā ca taṁsampayuttakānañca dhammānaṁ nissayapaccayena paccayo.
original.edition: Mahāsaṅgīti Tipiṭaka (roman script, based on the Sixth Council edition), SuttaCentral bilara-data root/pli/ms; niggahita written ṁ

paraphrase: Support condition: the eye base supports eye-consciousness, and so on; and the matter in dependence on which the mind-element and mind-consciousness-element occur supports them and their associated dhammas.
translation_basis: paraphrase made by the unit author from the Pali where the passage was read locally; otherwise from the author's knowledge of the text
notes: Wording read in the local Mahāsaṅgīti root text (bilara-data); paraphrase by the unit author (skeleton phase; fidelity not yet checked). The text leaves this matter unnamed; the commentaries identify it as the heart-base (hadaya-vatthu).

original.text: Aññamaññapaccayoti—cattāro khandhā arūpino aññamaññapaccayena paccayo. Cattāro mahābhūtā aññamaññapaccayena paccayo. Okkantikkhaṇe nāmarūpaṁ aññamaññapaccayena paccayo.
original.edition: Mahāsaṅgīti Tipiṭaka (roman script, based on the Sixth Council edition), SuttaCentral bilara-data root/pli/ms; niggahita written ṁ

paraphrase: Conascence and mutuality: the four immaterial aggregates condition one another; the four great elements condition one another; at the moment of descent into the womb, mentality and materiality condition one another.

original.text: Natthipaccayoti—samanantaraniruddhā cittacetasikā dhammā paṭuppannānaṁ cittacetasikānaṁ dhammānaṁ natthipaccayena paccayo.
original.edition: Mahāsaṅgīti Tipiṭaka (roman script, based on the Sixth Council edition), SuttaCentral bilara-data root/pli/ms; niggahita written ṁ

paraphrase: Absence and disappearance: mental dhammas that have just ceased are conditions for the present mental dhammas by way of absence and of disappearance.

original.text: Pacchājātapaccayoti—pacchājātā cittacetasikā dhammā purejātassa imassa kāyassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo.

paraphrase: Postnascence: later-arising mental dhammas are conditions for this earlier-arisen body.

original.text: Siyā kusalaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca kusalo dhammo uppajjeyya hetupaccayā. Siyā kusalaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca akusalo dhammo …
